summary: Gitea is a self-hosted Git service (Go, xorm ORM) with CRUD over users, organizations/teams, repositories, issues & pull requests, projects/kanban, Gitea Actions CI runs, packages registry, webhooks, deploy/SSH/GPG keys, OAuth2 apps & access tokens, notifications, and system settings - all persisted as xorm tables with read-back endpoints.

scope enforced via where user_id=$doer in delete; revoke of own grant has no separate guard, covered by auth
bound to actor's own uid via service; only feature-disable checks (per login type) not a guard
pure session teardown, no data mutation requiring guard
admin-gated by route middleware (AdminRequired), not an in-service guard; service-level uniqueness checks present as errors not guards

same as update_avatar: no in-hander guard, access only by reqOrgOwnership() route.

DeleteWebhookByRepoID / DeleteWebhookByOwnerID validate only that a hook exists under the given scope; ownership/admin enforcement is entirely in the route middleware (repo reqAdmin, org reqOrgOwnership, admin group).
Guard is internalized as an atomic conditional UPDATE (WHERE last_used_passcode IS NULL OR != passcode), not a separate pre-read edge; replay/TOCTOU rejected by the row lock + affected==0 check.

Credential existence and sign_count check happen inside the webauthn library validation (ValidateLogin) before the UpdateSignCount write; the clone_warning check is done in-memory from the challenge response, not a DB precondition.
